# S131 — Self-host check cost and base branch: cache projectBuild git calls; read the base branch

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

S114 later notes: projectBuild runs 1-3 git calls per project on every snapshot and status call (not measured), and the base branch is hard-coded as refs/heads/main because the registry has no base-branch field.

S109 later note (2026-10-26): at the 1 s Runs interval every Runs change makes the TUI refetch, and the daemon calls BoardRuns uncached, so a busy run may cost about one extra relay-run list per second per client (not measured).
